# scripts/ops/Connect-AvdLandingZone.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Signs in to Microsoft Graph once for the whole Cloud Shell session, so the preflight, -Fix, the demo and the cleanup don't each ask for a device code.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-ClientId` | string | no |  | The operator app's client ID; defaults to $env:AVD_GRAPH_CLIENT_ID. Kept in $env for the scripts run after this one. |
| `-SubscriptionId` | string | no |  |  |
